options.text: Changing the object storage class makes each presigned URL usable only once.
options.explanation: Storage class does not change presigned authorization becomes single-use.

source.title: S3 presigned URL reuse and expiry

question: A CloudFront distribution serves a custom HTTPS origin. A policy requires encryption both from viewers to CloudFront and from CloudFront to the origin. The viewer certificate alone is already configured. What else must be designed?

options.text: Use HTTP-only to the origin because the viewer TLS session is automatically tunneled unchanged end to end.
options.explanation: CloudFront creates connection origin separate.

options.text: Install only a self-signed unmatched origin certificate and assume all origins are trusted.
options.explanation: Validation certificate/hostname origin remains required.

options.text: Enforce HTTPS for viewers but retain HTTP-only connections from CloudFront to the custom origin.
options.explanation: Policy viewer not meets encryption for hop CloudFront to origin.

options.text: Enforce HTTPS viewer behavior and configure the origin HTTPS policy with a valid certificate matching the origin hostname.
options.explanation: Both connection TLS separate; certificate viewer does not automatically secures connection origin.

question: A security review asks whether supported resource policies expose resources to principals outside the trusted organization. It is not asking for malware scanning or an API history report. Which capability most directly answers the question?

options.text: IAM Access Analyzer external-access analysis with the intended zone of trust.
options.explanation: Analysis policy identifies access that may to principal in outside limit trust that determined.

options.text: CloudTrail management event lookup alone.
options.explanation: History activity not shows all access that allowed but not yet used.

options.text: Amazon Macie content classification alone.
options.explanation: Classification data sensitive does not replace analysis resource policy that is supported.

options.text: Amazon Inspector vulnerability scanning alone.
options.explanation: Vulnerability scanning is not analysis exposure resource policy across trust.

question: S3 objects encrypted with a customer managed KMS key must replicate to a bucket in another account using a destination customer managed key. Versioning and a supported replication rule are configured. Which permissions must the design include? Select TWO.

options.text: Allow the role to replicate to the destination and use the destination key through destination policies.
options.explanation: Authorization destination includes bucket and key; permissions source only is not sufficient to.

options.text: Grant only ListBucket on the source and assume all object and KMS operations follow automatically.
options.explanation: ListBucket does not include all operation object replication or cryptography.

options.text: Use an AWS managed key and edit its policy arbitrarily to trust any external account.
options.explanation: AWS managed key not managed customer such as CMK.

options.text: Allow the replication role to read/decrypt the required source data through appropriate S3 and source-key permissions.
options.explanation: Role must can reads version source and uses key for flow that is required.

options.text: Remove versioning after the first object is copied to simplify continuous replication.
options.explanation: Versioning is prerequisite mechanism replication that used.
